text:
mike_r: Running the workshop sample today and hit a weird oscillation where pagination emits bursts then goes quiet for ~20s, repeatedly. Happens under load with concurrency=5.

anya: Oscillation? Like it recovers then stalls again? That sounds like interplay between retry backoff and token refill.

mike_r: Exactly. Repro: start sample with --parallel=5 --pageSize=150 and run a synthetic burst. You see series: pages stream for 5s, then quiet 20s, then brief resume. Stack: sdk-js v0.8.0.

tim_sdk: Interesting — v0.8 switched to per-request permits + jitter, but we also introduced an exponential retry that clamps to a max sleep. Could be a mis-tuned clamp where many workers all align on the clamp boundary and re-drain tokens in sync.

mike_r: Logs (trimmed):

```
[2026-05-02T07:11:00Z] INFO paginator: page=6 start
[2026-05-02T07:11:00Z] WARN http: 429 x-retry-after=1
[2026-05-02T07:11:00Z] INFO throttle: tokens_left=0
[2026-05-02T07:11:01Z] INFO throttle: refill +2 (tokens=2)
[2026-05-02T07:11:01Z] INFO retry: sleeping 1000ms attempt=1
[2026-05-02T07:11:03Z] INFO paginator: pages processed=12
[2026-05-02T07:11:21Z] INFO paginator: idle - waiting for permits
```

mike_r: That pattern repeats. Refill happens quickly but paginator stays idle until many tokens accumulate.

anya: Do the workers try to lease multiple permits per page? Some callers request a small batch (N tokens) to minimize roundtrips. If every worker asks for N, they'll all block until enough tokens накопятся.

tim_sdk: Our SDK has two modes: lease-per-request (default) and lease-batch (opt-in). The sample used a small batch lease for throughput. In v0.8 the jittered refill expects mostly single-token leases. Batch leases + jitter can create beat patterns.

ops-bot: Noted: created alert A-8843 for "sample pagination oscillation under client throttle".

anya: Fix options: 1) change sample to use lease-per-request for pagination (lower per-request throughput but stable), 2) add randomized stagger to worker starts so they don't align, 3) tune ThrottleConfig to allow tiny burst and faster refill.

mike_r: I'd prefer sample stay high-throughput but predictable for workshops. Maybe set DEFAULT_PAGE_CONCURRENCY=3 and switch to lease-per-request + small burst window {maxTokens:12,refillMs:120,burst:3,jitter:true}. Also add a small startup jitter so workers don't align.

tim_sdk: I can add a helper in the SDK that exposes a sample-safe config and an env flag REDWOOD_SAMPLE_SAFE_THROTTLE=true so samples can opt in without users changing code. That helper would set per-request leases, provide a default burst and startup jitter.

anya: Also add a short note in onboarding README about "burst lease vs per-request lease" and how older SDKs (<=0.7) differed (global bucket vs per-request) so customers understand parity issues.

mike_r: I'll open a PR to: update sample defaults (concurrency 3), add startup jitter of 100-300ms per worker, use per-request leasing, and include ThrottleConfig snippet and a repro script that simulates alignment.

ops-bot: Created task T-9922 "samples: prevent pagination lease alignment oscillation" https://redwood/tasks/T-9922

devex-bot: Linked T-9922 to PR when available and added label onboarding.

mike_r: PR opened: https://redwood/pr/1012 - includes sample-safe throttle helper usage, default concurrency change, and README doc explaining lease modes and recommended configs for dev vs prod.

anya: Nice. One more nicety: add a tiny telemetry event in samples when they hit 429s and long idle (>10s) so we can see how often this affects new users. Make it opt-out for privacy.

tim_sdk: I'll follow up with a small SDK helper and a unit test that asserts no full-alignment under randomized startup seeds.

mike_r: Thanks. Will merge once tim's helper is in. This should stop workshop confusion.
